scope.units: proper seconds, proper cm^-3; source rate units per IgmRates
scope.model: Case A escape; clumping=1; primary photoelectron heat

derived_fields.dr_cooling_erg_cm3_s: zero for T/11605<=0.8, otherwise same returned dr_raw
derived_fields.ci_floor_cm3_s: exact 1e-20 for selected source floor channels, otherwise zero
derived_fields.ce_cap_erg: same returned ce value if source cap predicate true, otherwise zero
derived_fields.dr_excluded_erg_cm3_s: same returned dr_raw for source low branch, otherwise zero

construction.grid: T_j=exp(j*ln(1e6)/65536), j=0..65536; force exact 1 and 1e6 endpoints; store actual T and lnT
construction.source: call immutable canonical igm_rates at each node, store 15 fields and branch masks
construction.interpolation: unguarded cell: linear interpolation of ln(coefficient) in stored lnT, exp result; exact node returns stored value
construction.zero_floor: structural zero exact; do not log zero; same-mask double floor endpoints return exact 1e-20
construction.domain: original error for invalid/outside; no extrapolation or projection
construction.tails: retain all positive values, no added clipping/floor/flush
construction.artifact: persist versioned source-bound node/column table under data/ with dimensions, units and SHA256; load roundtrip before timing

branch_guards.extra: detect HI CI floor mask transition between node endpoints
branch_guards.mark: guard every closed cell containing boundary and every cell with endpoint source mask difference, both sides if exact node
branch_guards.query: guarded cell returns entire unchanged canonical igm_rates bundle; record indices/endpoints/reason and fallback counts
branch_guards.other: no additional unobserved branch transition allowed

validation.oracle: immutable canonical Rust igm_rates and 96 retained literal-C rows
validation.structural_zero: bitwise exact zero; selected CI floor exact 1e-20; all branch masks exact
validation.grid: all nodes and each cell at log fractions 1/4,1/2,3/4; threshold next_down/exact/next_up; endpoints; detected floor guards
validation.invalid: same error variant/message for below 1, above 1e6, negative/zero, NaN, infinities

slope.stencil: T*exp(+/-1e-6), within one smooth unguarded branch
slope.zeros: exact zero slope for constant zeros/floors

validation.rhs_matrix: 257 log T incl endpoints x fractions [0,0,0],[2e-4,1e-5,1e-8],[.5,.25,.25],[1,0,1]; nh=1e-4 or1, nhe=.08nh; zero/nonzero photo, Tcmb2.7255/100, h0 and subset1e-17, absent He and invalid fixtures
validation.rhs_signed_gate: abs(delta)<=1e-300+2e-6*sum(abs(original contributing primitive terms)) in field units
validation.conservation_gate: nuclei/charge <=1e-12 gross rate scale; thermal+binding+escape-photo-CMB <=1e-12 gross energy scale, each +1e-300
validation.errors: reference failure remains same variant/message; no projection
validation.failure_record: exact input bits, coordinate, field, original/candidate, raw evidence and cumulative calls

saved_history_samples.gate: all coefficients and diagnostics, separately report fallback fraction/worst error
saved_history_samples.limit: temperature samples only; no reconstructed heat/RHS or trajectory claim

benchmark.consume: complete output black_box and nondegenerate checksum

limits.accounting: all constructor/validation/warmup/fallback/internal/timed calls count cumulatively across local and NCP; reserve batches; retain goal and prior task costs

commands.binding: record exact argv/host/cwd/CPU/toolchain/executable/source/table hashes, cumulative counts and quotas, stdout/stderr/exit/resources

allowed.rhs_adapter: copy pinned thermal/point wrappers, replace only rate-provider calls, preserve duplicate-call count and operation/validation order

transition.ready: after serialization and pin check dispatch lower-tier worker immediately
transition.local_pass: run single bounded NCP component benchmark if capacity
transition.failure: stop first numerical/identity/resource/transport failure; no grid enlargement or gate relaxation
transition.review: fresh independent Astra on source substitutions/persisted table/gates/raw/cumulative usage
transition.repair: at most one separately approved targeted repair within remaining allocation
transition.component_pass: new separate finite driver integration allocation and source/binary/output identity
transition.future_trajectory: matched q=0,+.01 short histories with unchanged AX05 solver/ledgers, common scale factors; fraction/temperature/thermal and photon <=1e-6 scaled budgets, original ledgers/parity; response error <=0.1 measured resolution; no full-history claim from short test

restored_specifications.rhs_inputs: Nonzero gamma=[1e-14,2e-14,3e-14] s^-1; matching heat=gamma*1e-12 erg/absorber/s. Zero-photo case uses Tcmb=2.7255; nonzero-photo cases use Tcmb=2.7255 and 100.
restored_specifications.rhs_scales: Fraction scales: gross contributing photo+CI+RR+DR events divided by element density. w_dt scale: sum absolute photo heat, CI/RR/DR/CE/free-free sinks, CMB exchange and expansion work, divided by nh. Temperature scale: gross w_dt scale times 2*nh/(3*kB*particles), plus abs(T)*gross electron-production rate/particles.
restored_specifications.slope_samples: 4097 uniformly spaced open-domain logT samples, plus table knots adjacent to guard cells. Compare only stencils entirely within one smooth unguarded branch.
restored_specifications.finite_values: Constructor rejects nonfinite or nonpositive nonzero coefficients. Unexpected interpolated zero, nonfinite or nonpositive output is a candidate failure. Preserve exact structural zeros.
restored_specifications.timing_controls: Reference and candidate pairs use identical input order and counts. Numerical comparisons precede timing. Numerical PASS does not require speedup. Verify transferred executable/source/table hashes and CPU/RAM/disk availability before launch; preserve all started-command costs.

future_history_exact_budgets.photons: Normalized L1 count/energy differences<=1e-6, with AX05 floors 1e-8 photons/H and 1e-8 eV/H
future_history_exact_budgets.ledgers: Per-step photon/augmented-energy residual<=1e-10; cumulative<=1e-8; nuclei/charge/reflection parity<=1e-12. Original AX05 positive normalizations apply.
future_history_exact_budgets.unresolved_resolution: Unknown response-resolution error remains HOLD for the response claim.
